title: Comparing Strings with equals() and Slicing with substring()
description: Use x.equals(y) to compare the text inside two String objects and z.substring(start, end) to extract slices of characters.

steps.description: Create String x = "Test" and String y = new String("Test"), then compare their contents with x.equals(y) on line 6.
Set String z = "tan" on line 10 and print z.substring(1, 2) + z.substring(0, 1) on line 11.

steps.question: For z = "tan", what substrings do z.substring(1, 2) and z.substring(0, 1) extract, and what is printed?
steps.answer: substring(start, end) includes index start up to (but not including) index end, so z.substring(1, 2) is "a" and z.substring(0, 1) is "t", printing "at".

steps.description: Step to line 11 to see x.equals(y) print its message and z.substring(1, 2) + z.substring(0, 1) print "at".
